claim:gg-01-differential-adhesion-sortin.proposition:
pbg-artistoo reproduces Fig-12 sorting: heterotypic fraction falls 0.479 -> 0.379 (-21%, mean of
3 seeds) with connectedness 0.998 — clean differential-adhesion engulfment, no motility.
claim:gg-01-differential-adhesion-sortin.hypothesis:
The heterotypic boundary fraction decreases monotonically over ~176 MCS as the aggregate sorts,
and mean cell connectedness stays near 1.0 (engulfment, not fragmentation). Robust across seeds.

claim:gg-02-sign-and-temperature-control.hypothesis:
Checkerboard: heterotypic fraction rises (unlike cells prefer contact). High-T: sorting fails —
cells crumble/mix. If the heterotypic fraction alone cannot separate high-T mixing from sorting,
that is itself a finding about the order parameter's sufficiency.

narrative.question:
Does the pbg-artistoo wrapper over the Artistoo Cellular Potts Model reproduce the
differential-adhesion-driven rearrangements of Glazier & Graner (1993) — cell sorting /
engulfment (Fig 12), checkerboard intercalation (Fig 7), and the high-temperature mixing
transition (Fig 9) — from the paper's own surface-tension energies, with no cell motility?
